title: Climate Blanket, Summer Ice Silk Cooling Blanket, Smooth, Lightweight, Double Bed, King Size
body_html:
Cooling Blanket for Summer – Soft, Double-Sided & Pet-Friendly

Enjoy restful sleep even on hot summer days with our high-quality summer cooling blanket. The innovative cooling technology and soft, double-sided material provide noticeable refreshment – ideal for warm nights, those who sleep hot, and air-conditioned rooms.

Product Features:
Cool-to-Touch Effect: Cools instantly upon skin contact – perfect for heat waves
Double-Sided: Both sides offer pleasant coolness and soft comfort
Sizes:

• Queen: 200 x 230 cm

Moisture-Regulating: Ultra-absorbent fibers ensure a dry sleeping environment
Easy Care: Machine washable on a gentle cycle (cold), tumble dry low
Areas of Use:

Ideal for bedrooms, guest rooms, caravans, sofas, or travel
Suitable for adults, children, and pets
Especially pleasant in air-conditioned rooms or during summer heat

Note:

This blanket does not contain an electronic cooling function. The cooling effect is most pronounced when in contact with cool air, e.g., from a window. For example, in air-conditioned rooms.

Product images:

Warning:

Not suitable for children under 36 months due to small parts which may pose a choking hazard!
